articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed, avg 12.2/cycle; the first full day on the Opus 5.5 selector

experiment: Reverted 2026-09-18-gap-countries-latam-pacific. On the three clean Opus 5 days, uniqueRegions was 6/5/5 against a 6/6/5 baseline, and Mexico, Argentina and the Philippines produced no datelines. AF fell 7→4→3, below its guardrail floor. No new experiment: the pause gate holds until 2026-09-25 for the Opus 5.5 baseline.
weakestArea: Regional balance within the Americas. AM holds 28 of 61 datelines (46%), about half of them Washington, New York or the Bay Area, driven today by UNGA week. Latin America had 5 datelines and Oceania 1 in the metric (Nuku'alofa, plus Sydney on a US diesel story). That is better than any clean experiment day, but it falls on the new selector model, so it is a first baseline point rather than an effect.
watching: Iran is setting terms for talks through Qatar while Washington moves to ground Iran Air, so the coercive and diplomatic tracks are still running together.
UNGA week brings Guterres's warning of ethnic cleansing, Sharaa's rejection of the Golan annexation, Trump rejecting UN AI oversight, and a G20 invitation to Putin.
In Venezuela, Trump met Maduro's deputy while Caracas courts its creditors, which may be the start of a restructuring track.
Seven rebel groups in Ethiopia have aligned against Abiy, and a Tigray (Mekelle) dateline points to renewed northern instability.
AI model pricing is falling fast: Anthropic cut Opus prices and OpenAI halved Sol and Luna pricing on the same day.
coverageGaps: Asia has 5 datelines against 10 the day before, with nothing from Japan, Korea or Southeast Asia beyond one Sri Lanka story.
Politics is 38% of output (23/61), and much of it is New York UNGA speech coverage that clusters on one dateline.
Science sources are thin on primary journals, with Nature 1 and the rest relayed through regional press.
context: Today is the first full day with Opus 5.5 selecting, which confounds any regional read. The reverted GAP_COUNTRIES entries take effect from the next cycle, and regional breadth should be re-baselined on 09-24 and 09-25 before any new experiment once the gate lifts. Cycle time rose to 1483s from 1433s yesterday, within normal range.
